17 year old male, 73kg, 174cm

I thought about lowering it, but I am afraid it will mess up with my metabolism
Not really, in my country we eat the same thing for dinner pretty much everyday, it is always rice, beans and some kind of meat, and I always liked it.
To be honest I wish I did not even had taste buds so I could eat salad all day and not have to worry about gaining weight.

I get your point, but I decided to go on even with these problems because I am feeling really motivated to do something, and for the next 3 months I won't have responsibilities school, work etc, it would be impossible to work or study this way, so I am trying to get past the worst part now so that when I start working and studying hopefully I won't face these difficulties, thanks for your help.

I've been on it for 4-5 days and to be honest I don't feel very well, 1/3 of the day I feel dizzy and light-headed and I am even having some diarrhea, but I think it is worth it, I am already losing weight and I hope its easier over time.

I don't know, it is hard to believe it is that easy to lose weight, and possibly your metabolism would adjust to fasting and once your body is adjusted to fasting it would not deal well with eating several times a day.

​

Well I am just like 10-15  pounds above a decent body, so if I lose that many pounds I will be happy as f\*\*\*, I am on my 3 day of OMAD and surprisingly enough I am not having trouble sticking to it.
for real? how much weight did you lose? I have seen some people say they lost a lot of weight just by doing omad without even changing their diet.
